name: Decay
description: DECAY *If you found this model useful, please give it a like! Experimental LoRa for Z image Turbo, for decay effect, aging , decrepitude ... How to use: - Add the LoRa to your workflow; recommended very high strength ( 2.0 to 6.0 ) And that's all! Information: In the example images you have the image without LoRa and then with LoRa with the indicated strength. With low strength, the Lora can serve as a gentle detailer. It hasn't been tested with negative strength, who knows what it will do! :P Experiment with it! Recommended checkpoint: SWIFT! . Enjoy!
